claim: An unrelated commit with a matching tree could be used as source_revision.
evidence: A tree-equal orphan commit was accepted even though it was not an ancestor of HEAD.
impact: Source identity and commit-time evidence could be decoupled from the delivered branch.
required_action: Require base_revision to be an ancestor of source_revision and source_revision to be an ancestor of HEAD.

prevention.action: Use git merge-base --is-ancestor for both source lineage edges.
